training.trainable_parameters: Full-parameter DeepSpeed ZeRO3 BF16 model forward with FP32 optimizer state
training.continuation_optimizer: Both branches reset optimizer and scheduler identically, initialize weights from exact same first-epoch final checkpoint.
training.trajectory_policy: Retain teacher outcomes including failed/partial trajectories. No success-only filtering. Infrastructure interruptions get bounded recovery; a terminal attempt still missing verifier reward scores0. Export only actual model conversations; report zero-supervision cases.

probe.reward: Original verifier numeric score; missing reward maps to0 per explicit user instruction, raw score/error preserved. Center scores over4rollouts per question.
probe.drop: Constant-score questions only; missing scores are0, not a reason to discard a whole question.
probe.average: Arithmetic mean over valid question gradients, no norm weighting
probe.score: dot(g_avg,d_i), full trainable parameters, no projection or preconditioning
probe.no_valid_questions: If all70 questions have constant scores, record no signal and use uniform environment probabilities; no replacement probes.
probe.parallel_execution: Up to4 single-H200 full-parameter gradient shards after all280 probe rollouts; each question equal weight. At most4 FP32 shard vectors stored; no projection.
probe.forward_precision: BF16 model, matching actual DeepSpeed module.bfloat16(); actualTrainer/LigerCE. Per-row gradients accumulated in FP32 external buffers.
probe.numerical_audit: runs/gradient-precision-check/result.json: legacyFP32autocast differs; new gradient computations use training_bf16.

environment_resampling.zero_variance: Uniform probability if all candidate dots equal

evaluation.uniform_reuse: Reuse original70 first repeats with original seeds, append210 new repeats. Preserve old artifacts and apply new missing-as-zero rule only in new derived records.
metrics: per-task mean and success count out of4
paired task-level differences and task bootstrap CIs
evaluation.note: All70 benchmark questions provide selection feedback. No independent heldout set in this experiment.

environment_runtime.semantics: Read-only reuse of original prepared task definitions/images and task-specific seed injection with byte/mode/root-ownership verification.

pilot_gate: Reuse validated harness and start32-way after per-pod student concurrent-generation smoke; no new first-batch teacher pilot.

student_serving_execution.reason: Reuse the validated009 vLLM0.32CUDA13 student stack and flags; no serving-method change in this experiment.

empty_sft_export_policy.scope: Terminal attempted rollout with no accepted assistant generation available for original SFT export
empty_sft_export_policy.outcome: Keep raw verifier reward/null and raw API/error history; missing reward maps to0 per user. Do not invent an assistant turn.
empty_sft_export_policy.export: Zero SFT rows and zero gradient contribution; score still enters the four-rollout question mean.
